4.4. Reaction of mono-substituted 1,2-allenyl phosphine
oxides with PhSeCl
4.4.1. 3-Hydroxy-4-methyl-2-phenylselanyl-1(E)-pentenyl diphenyl
phosphine oxide (E- 2l)
Typical procedure IV. To a solution of PhSeCl (55.6 mg, 0.2 mmol)
in 2 mL of MeCN and 1.5 mL of H 2O was added a solution of 1l
(57.3 mg, 0.3 mmol) in 1 mL of MeCN at room temperature. Then
the resulting mixture was stirred at 70
/C14 C for 34 min. After com-
plete consumption of the starting material as monitored by TLC
(eluent: dichloromethane/ethyl acetate ¼10:1), the mixture was
quenched with 5 mL of H
2O, extracted with 20 /C2 3 mL of diethyl
ether, washed with 5 mL of brine, and dried over anhydrous
Na2SO4. Filtration and evaporation afforded the crude product,
which was analyzed by 1H NMR study to show an E-2l/Z-3l ratio of
97:3. Flash chromatography on silica gel (dichloromethane/ethyl
acetate¼10:1, then 5:1) afforded E-2l (73.8 mg, 82%) (E -2l/Z-
3l¼97:3).
4.4.2. 3-Hydroxy-2-phenylselanyl-1(E)-propenyl diphenyl
phosphine oxide (E- 2m)
The reaction of 1m (72.5 mg, 0.30 mmol) and PhSeCl
(86.4 mg, 0.45 mmol) in 3.0 mL of H
2O and 3.0 mL of CH 3CN at
70 /C14 C for 9 h afforded E-2m (65.6 mg, 52.5%) and Z-3m (17.8 mg,
14%) ( E-2m/Z-3m¼79:21 by 1H NMR analysis of the crude
product).
4.4.3. 3-Hydroxy-2-phenylselanyl-1(E)-pentenyl diphenyl
phosphine oxide (E- 2n)
The reaction of 1n (81.1 mg, 0.30 mmol) and PhSeCl (86.8 mg,
0.45 mmol) in 1.5 mL of H 2O and 3 mL of CH 3CN at 70 /C14 C for 21 min
afforded E-2n (104.6 mg, 78%) as a solid (E -2n/Z-3n>99:1 by 1H
NMR analysis of the crude product).
4.4.4. 3-Hydroxy-2-phenylselanyl-1(E)-nonenyl diphenyl
phosphine oxide (E- 2o)
The reaction of 1o (96.8 mg, 0.30 mmol) and PhSeCl (85.5 mg,
0.45 mmol) in 1.5 mL of H 2O and 3 mL of CH 3CN at 70 /C14 C for 70 min
afforded E-2o (1 10.6 mg, 74%) (E-2o/Z-3o¼98:2 by 1H NMR analysis
of the crude product).
4.4.5. 3-Hydroxy-4-phenyl-2-phenylselanyl-1(E)-butenyl diphenyl
phosphine oxide (E- 2p)
The reaction of 1p (101.0 mg, 0.30 mmol) and PhSeCl (87.4 mg,
0.45 mmol) in 2.3 mL of H 2O and 2.3 mL of CH 3CN at 70 /C14 C for
105 min afforded E-2p (1 18.1 mg, 77%) (E-2p/Z-3p¼96.5:3.5 by 1H
NMR analysis of the crude product).
4.5. Reaction of optically active 1,2-allenyl phosphine oxides
with PhSeCl
4.5.1. S-3-Hydroxy-2-phenylselanyl-1(E)-butenyl diphenyl
phosphine oxide (S-2b )
The reaction of S-(þ)-1b (76.2 mg, 0.30 mmol) and PhSeCl
(86.7 mg, 0.45 mmol) in 0.3 mL of H 2O and 6 mL of CH 3CN for
12 min afforded S-(þ)-2b (1 10.5 mg, 86%) as a solid. Mp 150–151/C14 C
(n-hexane/ethyl acetate). 1H NMR (300 MHz, CDCl 3) d 7.62–7.28 (m,
15H), 5.88 (d, J¼8.4 Hz, 1H), 5.62 (d, J¼20.1 Hz, 1H), 4.96–4.82 (m,
1H), 1.58 (d, J¼6.6 Hz, 3H); HPLC conditions: Chiralcel AD-H, hex-
ane/i-PrOH¼80:20, 0.8 mL/min, n¼230 nm, tR 12.6 (major), 17.3
(minor); [a]D
20 þ22.5 (c 1.01, CHCl3).

diphenyl phosphine oxide (S-2j )
The reaction of S-(þ)-1j (103.8 mg, 0.30 mmol, 99% ee) and
PhSeCl (88.5 mg, 0.45 mmol) of in 0.3 mL of H 2O and 6 mL of CH3CN
for 8 min afforded S-(þ)-2j (146.8 mg, 94%, 99% ee) as a liquid. 1H
NMR (300 MHz, CDCl 3) d 7.75 (dd, J1¼12.3 Hz, J2¼7.2 Hz, 2H), 7.54
(dd, J1¼17.1 Hz, J2¼6.9 Hz, 3H), 7.48–7.22 (m, 10H), 7.16–7.07 (m,
2H), 7.00–6.90 (m, 1H), 6.89–6.80 (m, 1H), 6.75 (d, J¼1 1.4 Hz, 1H),
6.52 (d, J¼6.9 Hz, 1H), 4.24 (t, J¼9.8 Hz, 1H), 2.22–2.05 (m, 1H),
1.98–1.83 (m, 1H), 0.80 (t, J¼7.2 Hz, 3H); HPLC conditions: Chiralcel
AD-H, hexane/ i-PrOH¼90:10, 0.7 mL/min, n¼230 nm, tR¼25.7;
[a]D
20 þ103.1 (c 0.96, CHCl3).
4.5.3. R-3-Hydroxy-2-phenylselanyl-1(E)-nonenyl diphenyl
phosphine oxide (R- 2o)
The reaction of R-(/C0 )-1o (97.6 mg, 0.30 mmol, 97% ee) and
PhSeCl (86.9 mg, 0.45 mmol) in 1.5 mL of H 2O and 3 mL of CH 3CN at
70 /C14 C for 30 min afforded R-(/C0 )-2o (1 18.2 mg, 79%, 97% ee) as
a liquid. 1H NMR (300 MHz, CDCl 3) d 7.64–7.31 (m, 15H), 5.78–5.57
(m, 2H), 4.70–4.58 (m, 1H), 1.97–1.73 (m, 2H), 1.66–1.45 (m, 1H),
1.44–1.13 (m, 7H), 0.86 (t, J¼6.2 Hz, 3H); HPLC conditions: Chiralcel
OD-H, hexane/ i-PrOH¼95:5, 0.7 mL/min, n¼230 nm, t
R 1 1.7 (ma-
jor), 13.5 (minor); [ a]D
20 /C0 25.15 (c 1.05, CHCl3).
